record.title: Evaluate precise execution stops and choose the next stock observation batch
record.intent: Admit stock two-word continuation only if private observation controls support it.
requirements: Separate private controls, stock inference and unknown emulator mechanisms.
Make thread coverage explicit before growing the device model.
acceptance: Decide whether supported precise stops justify stock adaptation or a different observer layer.
Select a bounded next question and retain unknown-access stopping and stock byte preservation.
Commit and push findings before the next experiment.
